note: Formatting a catalogue message (the ICU subset of README.md). message + locale + args -> output (the plain text: a tag's content kept, the tag itself dropped) and, for messages with tags, parts (the rich-text segments a renderer gets: {text} or {tag, text}, adjacent text merged, empty text dropped). '#' in a plural branch is the plural argument formatted with the locale's default number format (Intl.NumberFormat(locale)); {name} inserts the argument as a string, unformatted. error: the formatter refuses (missingArg: an argument the message names is absent; pluralNotNumber: the plural argument is not a finite number). Test-only messages, never catalogue keys. Go decodes the cases without parts.
